title: The God of Small Things
author: Arundhati Roy
summary: In Kerala, a pair of twins grows up in a family riven by caste, class and old resentments. A visit from a cousin in 1969 sets in motion events that will mark them for life.
readIf: you like richly worded novels that circle around a tragedy and make the small details feel enormous.
skipIf: you want a linear plot, or you cannot read about the abuse and death of children.

pairings.reason: A sprawling, playful Indian novel that makes an interesting contrast with this one's tight, sorrowful focus.
Equally affecting novel about lives crushed by rigid social rules, though in plainer prose.
Another poetic novel about trauma that keeps returning to the event at its centre.
